summary: Deep Fission, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its Non-Employee Director Compensation Policy, increasing annual equity awards, initial awards, and committee retainers, effective July 23, 2026. The modifications are routine compensation adjustments, not a special situation event. No transactional terms, strategic actions, or extraordinary corporate changes are involved. This filing is a standard disclosure of board-approved compensation policy changes, mapped as a routine current report with no special-situations implications. There are no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angles to analyze.
